request: Does the record support describing the missed sessions as low commitment?
common_facts: A trainee missed five of six mandatory lab sessions scheduled after the shift.
primary_fact: The only bus from the site left ten minutes before each session, and the trainee asked twice for a daytime lab.
changed_fact: A reliable shuttle served every session. The trainee wrote that they skipped the sessions because they did not want the credential.
distractor: The training sign-in sheets are printed on light blue paper.

request: Does the identical reporting form give both parties the same practical protection?
common_facts: A tenant and a building administrator use the same named complaint form.
primary_fact: The administrator sees the filer’s name before review and can deny the tenant’s pending renewal. The tenant has no comparable leverage.
changed_fact: An independent ombud receives the form, conceals both identities from each party and suspends adverse contract changes until review.
distractor: The form was last typeset in eleven-point font.

request: One participant found a job quickly. How should that affect the claim that temporary placements were more common than permanent positions in this cohort?
common_facts: The placement report covers 100 participants and quotes one participant who found permanent work quickly.
primary_fact: Sixty-two participants had temporary placements, sixteen had permanent placements, and the other twenty-two had neither recorded.
changed_fact: Sixteen participants had temporary placements, sixty-two had permanent placements, and the other twenty-two had neither recorded.
distractor: The report cover includes a photo of the training room.

request: Who bears responsibility for the interaction in this account?
common_facts: A club chair was shouted at by a volunteer during a budget meeting.
primary_fact: The chair had disclosed the volunteer’s private financial information and interrupted two requests to stop. The volunteer shouted once and left.
changed_fact: The volunteer shouted before either had spoken. The chair then stopped the meeting at the volunteer’s request and offered an exit without penalty.
distractor: The meeting agenda was printed on recycled paper.

request: Whose count is better supported in this record?
common_facts: A nationally recognized institute and an unaffiliated analyst publish incompatible attendance figures for the same event.
primary_fact: The analyst supplies timestamped entry records and a deduplication procedure. The institute supplies an undated estimate without a method.
changed_fact: The institute supplies timestamped entry records and a deduplication procedure. The analyst supplies an undated estimate without a method.
distractor: The report was distributed in landscape orientation.

request: Do repeated withdrawals establish that the applicant secretly wanted to fail?
common_facts: An applicant accepted then declined three volunteer coordinator roles. They said they liked leading but disliked being the person everybody could call after hours.
primary_fact: There is no further statement or independent record explaining the decisions.
changed_fact: The applicant’s contemporaneous journal consistently says they declined because the roles required weekend availability and includes the conflicting schedules.
distractor: All three role descriptions used the same organization logo.

request: Has the preservation grant made the loss good?
common_facts: Water damaged the only known audio recordings in a community collection, and a grant will fund new interviews.
primary_fact: An inventory and a university archivist confirmed that no duplicate recordings survive. Several original speakers have died.
changed_fact: An archivist recovered checksummed duplicate recordings containing every affected interview. The original tapes remain damaged.
distractor: The grant paperwork requires a distinct cover sheet.

request: Which of these two offers better suits the applicant’s situation?
common_facts: One studio pays 20 percent more and has weekend hours. The other pays less and leaves weekends free.
primary_fact: The applicant says both reducing debt and keeping the only shared day with their partner matter. Both jobs cover monthly bills.
changed_fact: The applicant says weekend availability is currently immaterial, both jobs cover monthly bills, and directs the comparison to maximize income this year.
distractor: The studio job descriptions were posted in the same week.
